title: Airwallex - Global financial infrastructure for cross-border business payments
clean_text: Airwallex built its own cross-border payments network on more than 60 banking licenses, expanding from FX and cross-border payments into a full-stack suite covering global business accounts, corporate cards, treasury, embedded finance, and expense management. It serves SMEs, e-commerce businesses, startups, tech companies, and financial institutions, with over 150,000 customers as of October 2025 -- including Brex, Rippling, Deel, TikTok, and Canva -- reaching $800 million in ARR and processing over $130 billion in transactions annually. Payments to 200+ countries mostly route through local payment rails rather than SWIFT, with 93% of transactions arriving same-day; North America and Europe are now its fastest-growing markets, scaling over 200% year-over-year as of mid-2025.

meta.target: SMEs, ecommerce businesses, startups, tech companies, financial institutions
